name: TriDF
definition: A hybrid explicit–implicit 3D representation for few-shot remote sensing novel view synthesis that decouples color and volume density to reduce the computational burden on implicit radiance fields and accelerate reconstruction from as few as 3 input views.
summary: TriDF is a hybrid 3D representation for few-shot novel view synthesis that decouples color and geometry to accelerate reconstruction by 30 times compared to standard NeRF methods.
